parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the time taken for the sledge to travel from A to B.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Determine the displacement of the sledge up the slope from point A at time $t = 24\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Show that the acceleration of the sledge as it moves from B back towards A is $0.50\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
The child and sledge have a total mass of $70\text{ kg}$. The component of the total weight of the child and sledge that acts down the slope is $80\text{ N}$.

Determine
parts.text: the frictional force on the sledge as it moves from B towards A,

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: the angle $\theta$ of the slope to the horizontal.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.stem:
The child on the sledge blows a whistle between $t = 4.0\text{ s}$ and $t = 8.0\text{ s}$. The whistle emits sound of frequency $900\text{ Hz}$. The speed of the sound in the air is $340\text{ m s}^{-1}$. A man standing at point A hears the sound.

Use Fig. 3.2 to
parts.text: determine the initial frequency of the sound heard by the man,

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: describe and explain qualitatively the variation, if any, in the frequency of the sound heard by the man.
